title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1987-09-20
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp (24/96) > Adobe Audition CC 2020 > TLH flac2496
source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME-80 mics > Sony D5M

ai_review.summary: Tinny, bass‑less recording makes the show difficult to enjoy
ai_review.review: The sole review criticizes the audio as overly bright and completely lacking low end, describing it as “terrible” and “tinny.” No musical performance details are provided, so listeners have no insight into how the band played that night. The poor sound quality dominates any assessment of this recording.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one very negative review (1 star) focusing on severe recording problems; no information about the performance to raise the rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as “tinny,” with all high‑end frequencies and virtually no bass, making the audio sound thin and unpleasant.
